title: Create one Space offline and read it back in the exact local destination directory

requirements.invariant: One accepted direct creation owns a caller-preallocated stable SpaceID in one exact Account and immutable Project-or-Business-Inventory scope, with canonical name and optional notes. Duplicate names under distinct IDs remain valid; copied names, route strings, backend paths and nullable scope pairs are never relationship authority.

Swift, MCP and PostgreSQL cannot yet promise one exact accepted Space name/notes value set. O-044 must approve separate language-neutral trim, control/NUL, Unicode-preservation and UTF-8-size rules before READY or executable writer work.

Direct creation has no implicit template, checklist, attachment, Item placement, archive, review, completion, Transaction, Invoice, payer, price, budget or accounting side effect. O-023/O-026/O-037 remain outside this operation.

The trusted command-specific Space-create authorization rule is unresolved. O-045 must decide whether active membership is sufficient or a specific role/capability is required; current Firebase member-write behavior cannot decide the target rule.

A Project-scoped command must validate an exact same-Account Project parent, but archived-parent eligibility is unresolved. O-046 must define one local/app/MCP/server lifecycle precondition while preserving existing archived-Project child Spaces.

With no network, one accepted operation atomically stores immutable operation evidence, one insert-only command and one separate local-only pending Space in the encrypted Principal/Account database, returns the shared queued receipt, renders the row immediately as partial, and survives termination until durable rejection or qualifying authoritative readback.

The caller-owned pending Space appears only in the exact active-membership Account and Project-or-Business-Inventory destination directory, at stable ID and projected revision 1, and always makes evidence partial. It cannot bypass membership loss, create authoritative completeness, leak cross-scope, or clear merely because an applied result arrived before the authoritative row.

The trusted handler authenticates and binds actor before OperationID, Space, Project or result disclosure, applies the future O-045 role rule, validates exact Account/parent/lifecycle under O-046, locks deterministically, inserts one server-owned active revision-1 Space plus immutable terminal result, and permits no direct Space/result write.

The isolated app and gated target MCP use identical create-space-v1 command bytes, fingerprint, scoped-user RPC and immutable result validation. Account/Principal come from authenticated context; neither accepts a service-role credential or logs Space text, canonical payload, token or key.

The entire slice remains spike-prefixed, synthetic and isolated from Firebase, hosted target, source migration and production. It grants no deployment, release or cutover authority; A-003/A-004 remain proposed and hosted authenticated PowerSync proof remains planned.

items: Reuse the verified SpaceCreationDraft, CreateSpaceCommand, SpaceCreating, SpaceCreationFormInput and DirectSpaceCreationUseCase. Provider types do not cross into LedgerTargetCore.
create-space-v1 binds exact Operation, Account, actor, caller SpaceID, immutable scope, approved O-044 canonical name/notes, finite capture milliseconds and zero preconditions.

Extend the existing spike_spaces authority with canonical optional notes and server-owned creation/update actor/time evidence while preserving exact composite Account/Project scope, immutable scope, lifecycle and positive revision constraints/indexes.
Extend immutable spike_operation_results to recognize create_space and exact Space subject/command fingerprint without a second Space identity or history authority.

One private search-path-pinned transaction authenticates, authorizes under O-045, parses and revalidates the exact command/fingerprint, validates Project existence/lifecycle under O-046, locks OperationID and Space identity deterministically, and inserts the Space/result once.
Exact replay returns the immutable result; changed reuse cannot rebind; concurrent claims on one SpaceID produce one deterministic success and one bounded conflict without affecting duplicate names.

Expose one explicit security-invoker Space-create RPC to authenticated only; PUBLIC/anon cannot execute the private handler, and anon/authenticated receive no direct Space or result mutation privilege.

Reuse Account-scoped Space/result SELECT visibility and enforce O-045 at the trusted command boundary. Anonymous, revoked, forged-actor, wrong-role, foreign-Project and cross-Account requests are non-enumerating; no direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policy is added.
Reuse the two exact on-demand active-Space Project/Inventory streams and scoped operation-result stream for authoritative readback. Pending operations/commands/Spaces never download as authority.
Authenticated hosted authorization, revocation and local-row absence remain required before A-004 can advance.

Add separate local-only pending Space and insert-only create command tables; accept operation/command/pending row atomically in the encrypted Account workspace, resolve exact replay before mutable local evidence, upload FIFO and retain transient failures.

Merge a valid caller-owned pending row into the existing exact destination directory only while its Principal/Account/scope membership sentinel is represented; mark the view partial. Durable rejection removes it; applied optimism persists until exact authoritative row readback; every result-before-row, row-before-result, membership loss/regain and restart ordering is explicit.

items: Use stable operation/result/error correlation and bounded queue timing without Space text, canonical JSON, identifiers, tokens or credentials. Connected retry/Sync latency remains a later rehearsal obligation.
All work stays in the dedicated target worktree/app and disposable local spike schema; Firebase remains unchanged and authoritative.
Rollback is disposal of synthetic local target data. No hosted resource, source import, migration, release, production write, feature-authority switch or cutover is authorized.

verification.expected: After O-044/O-046 approval, a clean reset proves exact schema, both scopes, canonical text, duplicate names, active revision-1 server audit, Project lifecycle, immutable scope and zero unrelated effects.
Exact replay/lost response returns one result and row; changed replay refuses; concurrent same-ID claims yield one winner; distinct IDs with equal names both succeed.

verification.expected: Verified stable identity/scope/zero-precondition semantics remain unchanged and approved O-044 submission vectors become exact across Swift, TypeScript and PostgreSQL.
Every O-045-approved active member role creates in each approved scope and reads only the authorized Space/result.
Anonymous, revoked, wrong-role, forged actor, direct DML, missing/foreign/archived-as-decided Project and cross-Account requests cannot mutate or enumerate Space/result evidence.
Both scopes atomically retain operation/command/pending Space across encrypted close/reopen; immediate exact-scope directory readback is partial and deterministic for duplicate names.
Transient failure retains work; durable rejection removes only the exact pending row; malformed/foreign/stale result or authority fails closed; Project lifecycle evidence follows O-046.

notes: Independent authority review returned NO-GO for READY because exact cross-runtime Space text, command-specific writer authorization and archived-Project parent eligibility are not canonical. The comment-only scaffolds reserve the complete physical boundary but execute nothing. Immediate picker readback is explicitly causal and partial: pending rows are exact Principal/Account/scope evidence, membership loss hides without discarding them, result arrival alone cannot clear them, and only durable rejection or exact authoritative readback reconciles. Broad source NewSpaceView/Space CRUD surfaces remain target_mapped and unclaimed because this slice converts only direct creation.
